lit_faust.credit: Title page of the first edition, 1808

lit_heidi.reason: Illustration from the 1919 Lippincott edition by Maria L. Kirk (d. 1938): over 70 years, public domain in the EU.

lit_tonio-kroeger.reason: Press photo of Thomas Mann, Nobel Foundation 1929; a simple photograph (Lichtbild, §72 UrhG) is protected 50 years from publication, long over. Shown as the author for Tonio Kröger.

lit_der-process.reason: Kafka (d. 1924), his own manuscript page: public domain. Chosen instead of the 1925 first-edition jacket, which Georg Salter (d. 1967) designed and is still protected.
